title: Raking Light
description: An Abbey Road enamel pin, an embroidered Revolver patch and a Sgt. Pepper drum badge laid out on pale cotton, with one lamp in your hand. Move it and the light rakes across them: satin stitches, raised gold and domed enamel catch it and throw long soft shadows away from the bulb. Lower the lamp to make the relief stand up.
intent: One light finished to the edge: a real point lamp grazing three height fields on a light ground, so stitch direction, enamel gloss and metal edges come alive as the light comes down to them, and the shadows stretch across the cloth.
